_meta: G7 fragment (owner: WOUND7). rules.g7_wounds: hit zones, bleeding, casualty care, shrapnel, visible panic (G7 master scope section 2). All numbers PROVISIONAL balance fixtures (untuned). wounds.gd reads this file directly when content/g7 is not merged into Content.rules().

g7_wounds._note_zones: w = base weight per zone (arm/leg weights are per limb). dmg = damage multiplier. bleed = hp per second added per wound (x clamp(dmg / 25, 0.5, 2)). ooa_s = out-of-action seconds (no fire). kill = head only: chance a head hit kills outright (else unconscious).
g7_wounds._note_mods: posture.prone (pinned, cowering, crawling) and cover levels (Morale.cover_level 1 light / 2 heavy) multiply zone weights: cover hides lower zones. facing = Damage.hit_side of the shooter.

survival._note: chance a down casualty survives when first treated: 1 - loss_per_min x minutes since going down, floor `floor`

panic._note: On break (morale < break_at) a soldier picks a visible panic state. Weights x trait / rank / fatigue factors. freeze lasts freeze_s then becomes flee. drop: drops the weapon (no fire) and flees.

g7_shrapnel._note: Shrapnel.burst profiles. frags = rays in a full circle (scaled by the sim detail level), radius = fragment reach (tiles), dmg = damage per connecting fragment at the centre (x (1 - 0.5 d / radius)), blast_r / blast_dmg = concussion core, supp = flinch suppression inside radius x 1.2. Shells use shell_scale on the weapon's damage and splash.
g7_shrapnel._note_detail: detail = [[max FULL units, ray factor]]: full rays in close fights, fewer in huge fights (same rules).
